title: TypingMind logo build: low-poly brain assembles from flying shards
summary: A slow, elegant logo reveal on near-black: a wireframe low-poly brain draws itself, coloured triangular shards fly in from off-screen and lock into the mesh, a soft glow ring pulses, the mark snaps into an app-icon squircle, then shrinks left as 'TypingMind' types on beside it with a red cursor and tagline 'The best frontend for LLMs'. Single continuous shot, no cuts.
fit_reason: Calm, premium, dark logo-assembly sting is a perfect intro/outro bumper for a SaaS brand; only needs our own mark swapped in.

palette.mood: dark premium, soft vignette glow, warm pastel shards

typography.display: clean geometric sans semibold (SF Pro / Inter-like) for wordmark; small light sans tagline
typography.size_behaviour: wordmark mid-size beside icon, centred lockup
typography.notes: Thin red/coral vertical text cursor blinks after typing; tagline ~25% of wordmark size in grey.

text_animation: typewriter per-letter with blinking coral caret
motion: shards fly in on curved paths with spin and ease-out lock
icon slides left to make room for wordmark
transitions: none, single continuous shot; morph icon -> lockup

pacing.hold_time_s: whole 21 s is one build; final lockup held ~4 s

sound.sfx: subtle tick/whoosh per shard, likely keyboard clicks on type

signature_moves: wireframe-first then fill: shards fly in and click into place
glow ring pulse when the mark completes
mark -> app icon -> horizontal lockup with typewriter wordmark

best_segments.what: coloured shards fly in and lock into the wireframe brain
glow pulse, squircle icon, then typewriter wordmark + tagline lockup

recreate.how: Remotion or HTML+GSAP with SVG: split our logo into triangles (Delaunay on the mark), animate each from random offscreen pos/rotation to final with staggered back.out easing; SVG stroke-dashoffset for wireframe; radial-gradient glow; then text typewriter.
recreate.prompt: Dark near-black #07080F background with soft vignette, logo drawn as a thin wireframe low-poly mesh, coloured triangle shards fly in and snap into place, a glow ring pulses, logo becomes an app icon and slides left as the wordmark types on with a coral caret and a small tagline.
